title: Edging
summary: EDG'ING, participle present tense Giving an edge; furnishing with an edge. 1. Inciting; urging on; goading; stimulating; instigating. 2. Moving gradually or sideways. 3. Furnishing with a border. EDG'

inlines.v: EDG'ING, participle present tense Giving an edge; furnishing with an edge. 1. Inciting; urging on; goading; stimulating; instigating. 2. Moving gradually or sideways. 3. Furnishing with a border. EDG'ING, noun That which is added on the border, or which forms the edge; as lace, fringe, trimming, added to a garment for ornament. Bordered with a rosy edging 1. A narrow lace. 2. In gardening, a row of small plants wet along the border of a flower-bed; as an edging of box.
